en.text: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

zhSimplified.text: 除酵节（又名逾越节）近了。

zhTraditional.text: 除酵節（又名逾越節）近了。

en.text: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司长和文士想法子怎么才能杀害耶稣，是因他们惧怕百姓。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司長和文士想法子怎麼才能殺害耶穌，是因他們懼怕百姓。

en.text: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

zhSimplified.text: 这时，撒但入了那称为加略人犹大的心；他本是十二门徒里的一个。

zhTraditional.text: 這時，撒但入了那稱為加略人猶大的心；他本是十二門徒裏的一個。

en.text: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

zhSimplified.text: 他去和祭司长并守殿官商量，怎么可以把耶稣交给他们。

zhTraditional.text: 他去和祭司長並守殿官商量，怎麼可以把耶穌交給他們。

en.text: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

zhSimplified.text: 他们欢喜，就约定给他银子。

zhTraditional.text: 他們歡喜，就約定給他銀子。

en.text: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 他应允了，就找机会，要趁众人不在跟前的时候把耶稣交给他们。 （太26·17—25；可14·12—21；约13·21—30）

zhTraditional.text: 他應允了，就找機會，要趁眾人不在跟前的時候把耶穌交給他們。 （太26‧17－25；可14‧12－21；約13‧21－30）

en.text: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

zhSimplified.text: 除酵节，须宰逾越羊羔的那一天到了。

zhTraditional.text: 除酵節，須宰逾越羊羔的那一天到了。

en.text: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Goand prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣打发彼得、约翰，说：「你们去为我们预备逾越节的筵席，好叫我们吃。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌打發彼得、約翰，說：「你們去為我們預備逾越節的筵席，好叫我們吃。」

en.text: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

zhSimplified.text: 他们问他说：「要我们在哪里预备？」

zhTraditional.text: 他們問他說：「要我們在哪裏預備？」

en.text: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们进了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的房子里去，

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們進了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟着他，到他所進的房子裏去，

en.text: Tellthe master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

zhSimplified.text: 对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越节的筵席。』

zhTraditional.text: 對那家的主人說：『夫子說：客房在哪裏？我與門徒好在那裏吃逾越節的筵席。』

en.text: Hewill show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

zhSimplified.text: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里预备。」

zhTraditional.text: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裏預備。」

en.text: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

zhSimplified.text: 他们去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的；他们就预备了逾越节的筵席。 （太26·26—30；可14·22—26；林前11·23—25）

zhTraditional.text: 他們去了，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的；他們就預備了逾越節的筵席。 （太26‧26－30；可14‧22－26；林前11‧23－25）

en.text: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

zhSimplified.text: 时候到了，耶稣坐席，使徒也和他同坐。

zhTraditional.text: 時候到了，耶穌坐席，使徒也和他同坐。

en.text: He said to them, “Ihave earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「我很愿意在受害以先和你们吃这逾越节的筵席。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「我很願意在受害以先和你們吃這逾越節的筵席。

en.text: forI tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，我不再吃这筵席，直到成就在 神的国里。」

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，我不再吃這筵席，直到成就在上帝的國裏。」

en.text: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Takethis and share it among yourselves,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了，说：「你们拿这个，大家分着喝。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌接過杯來，祝謝了，說：「你們拿這個，大家分着喝。

en.text: forI tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直等 神的国来到。」

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直等上帝的國來到。」

en.text: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “Thisis my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

zhSimplified.text: 又拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给他们，说：「这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们也应当如此行，为的是记念我。」

zhTraditional.text: 又拿起餅來，祝謝了，就擘開，遞給他們，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的，你們也應當如此行，為的是記念我。」

en.text: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “Thiscup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

zhSimplified.text: 饭后也照样拿起杯来，说：「这杯是用我血所立的新约，是为你们流出来的。

zhTraditional.text: 飯後也照樣拿起杯來，說：「這杯是用我血所立的新約，是為你們流出來的。

en.text: Butbehold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪，那卖我之人的手与我一同在桌子上。

zhTraditional.text: 看哪， 那賣我之人的手與我一同在桌子上。

en.text: TheSon of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

zhSimplified.text: 人子固然要照所预定的去世，但卖人子的人有祸了！」

zhTraditional.text: 人子固然要照所預定的去世，但賣人子的人有禍了！」

en.text: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就彼此对问，是哪一个要做这事。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就彼此對問，是哪一個要做這事。

en.text: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

zhSimplified.text: 门徒起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。

zhTraditional.text: 門徒起了爭論，他們中間哪一個可算為大。

en.text: He said to them, “Thekings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「外邦人有君王为主治理他们，那掌权管他们的称为恩主。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「外邦人有君王為主治理他們，那掌權管他們的稱為恩主。

en.text: Butnot so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

zhSimplified.text: 但你们不可这样；你们里头为大的，倒要像年幼的，为首领的，倒要像服事人的。

zhTraditional.text: 但你們不可這樣；你們裏頭為大的，倒要像年幼的，為首領的，倒要像服事人的。

en.text: Forwho is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

zhSimplified.text: 是谁为大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大吗？然而，我在你们中间如同服事人的。

zhTraditional.text: 是誰為大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大嗎？然而，我在你們中間如同服事人的。

en.text: “Butyou are those who have continued with me in my trials.

zhSimplified.text: 我在磨炼之中，常和我同在的就是你们。

zhTraditional.text: 我在磨煉之中，常和我同在的就是你們。

en.text: Iconfer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

zhSimplified.text: 我将国赐给你们，正如我父赐给我一样，

zhTraditional.text: 我將國賜給你們，正如我父賜給我一樣，

en.text: thatyou may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

zhSimplified.text: 叫你们在我国里，坐在我的席上吃喝，并且坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。」 （太26·31—35；可14·27—31；约13·36—38）

zhTraditional.text: 叫你們在我國裏，坐在我的席上吃喝，並且坐在寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。」 （太26‧31－35；可14‧27－31；約13‧36－38）

en.text: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

zhSimplified.text: 主又说：「西门！西门！撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；

zhTraditional.text: 主又說：「西門！西門！撒但想要得着你們，好篩你們像篩麥子一樣；

en.text: butI prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’ t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

footnotes.text: 22:32 The word for “brothers” here may be also correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 但我已经为你祈求，叫你不至于失了信心。你回头以后，要坚固你的弟兄。」

zhTraditional.text: 但我已經為你祈求，叫你不至於失了信心。你回頭以後，要堅固你的弟兄。」

en.text: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「主啊，我就是同你下监，同你受死，也是甘心！」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「主啊，我就是同你下監，同你受死，也是甘心！」

en.text: He said, “Itell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「彼得，我告诉你，今日鸡还没有叫，你要三次说不认得我。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「彼得，我告訴你，今日雞還沒有叫，你要三次說不認得我。」

en.text: He said to them, “WhenI sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又对他们说：「我差你们出去的时候，没有钱囊，没有口袋，没有鞋，你们缺少什么没有？」他们说：「没有。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又對他們說：「我差你們出去的時候，沒有錢囊，沒有口袋，沒有鞋，你們缺少甚麼沒有？」他們說：「沒有。」

en.text: Then he said to them, “Butnow, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「但如今有钱囊的可以带着，有口袋的也可以带着，没有刀的要卖衣服买刀。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「但如今有錢囊的可以帶着，有口袋的也可以帶着，沒有刀的要賣衣服買刀。

en.text: ForI tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ Forthat which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

zhSimplified.text: 我告诉你们，经上写着说：『他被列在罪犯之中。』这话必应验在我身上，因为那关系我的事必然成就。」

zhTraditional.text: 我告訴你們，經上寫着說：『他被列在罪犯之中。』這話必應驗在我身上，因為那關係我的事必然成就。」

en.text: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “Thatis enough.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「主啊，请看！这里有两把刀。」耶稣说：「够了。」 （太26·36—46；可14·32—42）

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「主啊，請看！這裏有兩把刀。」耶穌說：「夠了。」 （太26‧36－46；可14‧32－42）

en.text: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去，门徒也跟随他。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌出來，照常往橄欖山去，門徒也跟隨他。

en.text: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Praythat you don’ t enter into temptation.”

zhSimplified.text: 到了那地方，就对他们说：「你们要祷告，免得入了迷惑。」

zhTraditional.text: 到了那地方，就對他們說：「你們要禱告，免得入了迷惑。」

en.text: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

zhSimplified.text: 于是离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告，

zhTraditional.text: 於是離開他們約有扔一塊石頭那麼遠，跪下禱告，

en.text: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：「父啊！你若愿意，就把这杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」

zhTraditional.text: 說：「父啊！你若願意，就把這杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」

en.text: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

zhSimplified.text: 有一位天使从天上显现，加添他的力量。

zhTraditional.text: 有一位天使從天上顯現，加添他的力量。

en.text: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣极其伤痛，祷告更加恳切，汗珠如大血点滴在地上。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌極其傷痛，禱告更加懇切，汗珠如大血點滴在地上。

en.text: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

zhSimplified.text: 祷告完了，就起来，到门徒那里，见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，

zhTraditional.text: 禱告完了，就起來，到門徒那裏，見他們因為憂愁都睡着了，

en.text: and said to them, “Whydo you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

zhSimplified.text: 就对他们说：「你们为什么睡觉呢？起来祷告，免得入了迷惑！」 （太26·47—56；可14·43—50；约18·3—11）

zhTraditional.text: 就對他們說：「你們為甚麼睡覺呢？起來禱告，免得入了迷惑！」 （太26‧47－56；可14‧43－50；約18‧3－11）

en.text: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

zhSimplified.text: 说话之间，来了许多人。那十二个门徒里名叫犹大的，走在前头，就近耶稣，要与他亲嘴。

zhTraditional.text: 說話之間，來了許多人。那十二個門徒裏名叫猶大的，走在前頭，就近耶穌，要與他親嘴。

en.text: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他说：「犹大！你用亲嘴的暗号卖人子吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他說：「猶大！你用親嘴的暗號賣人子嗎？」

en.text: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

zhSimplified.text: 左右的人见光景不好，就说：「主啊！我们拿刀砍可以不可以？」

zhTraditional.text: 左右的人見光景不好，就說：「主啊！我們拿刀砍可以不可以？」

en.text: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

zhSimplified.text: 内中有一个人把大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。

zhTraditional.text: 內中有一個人把大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。

en.text: But Jesus answered, “Letme at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「到了这个地步，由他们吧！」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「到了這個地步，由他們吧！」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。

en.text: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Haveyou come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对那些来拿他的祭司长和守殿官并长老说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對那些來拿他的祭司長和守殿官並長老說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？

en.text: WhenI was with you in the temple daily, you didn’ t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”
They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

zhSimplified.text: 他们拿住耶稣，把他带到大祭司的宅里。彼得远远地跟着。

zhTraditional.text: 他們拿住耶穌，把他帶到大祭司的宅裏。彼得遠遠地跟着。

en.text: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在院子里生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他们中间。

zhTraditional.text: 他們在院子裏生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他們中間。

en.text: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

zhSimplified.text: 有一个使女看见彼得坐在火光里，就定睛看他，说：「这个人素来也是同那人一伙的。」

zhTraditional.text: 有一個使女看見彼得坐在火光裏，就定睛看他，說：「這個人素來也是同那人一夥的。」

en.text: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

zhSimplified.text: 彼得却不承认，说：「女子，我不认得他。」

zhTraditional.text: 彼得卻不承認，說：「女子，我不認得他。」

en.text: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

zhSimplified.text: 过了不多的时候，又有一个人看见他，说：「你也是他们一党的。」彼得说：「你这个人！我不是。」

zhTraditional.text: 過了不多的時候，又有一個人看見他，說：「你也是他們一黨的。」彼得說：「你這個人！我不是。」

en.text: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

zhSimplified.text: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：「他实在是同那人一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。」

zhTraditional.text: 約過了一小時，又有一個人極力地說：「他實在是同那人一夥的，因為他也是加利利人。」

en.text: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

zhSimplified.text: 彼得说：「你这个人！我不晓得你说的是什么！」正说话之间，鸡就叫了。

zhTraditional.text: 彼得說：「你這個人！我不曉得你說的是甚麼！」正說話之間，雞就叫了。

en.text: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Beforethe rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

zhSimplified.text: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得便想起主对他所说的话：「今日鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」

zhTraditional.text: 主轉過身來看彼得，彼得便想起主對他所說的話：「今日雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」

en.text: He went out, and wept bitterly.
The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

zhSimplified.text: 看守耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，

zhTraditional.text: 看守耶穌的人戲弄他，打他，

en.text: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

zhSimplified.text: 又蒙着他的眼，问他说：「你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」

zhTraditional.text: 又蒙着他的眼，問他說：「你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？」

en.text: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.
As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 天一亮，民间的众长老连祭司长带文士都聚会，把耶稣带到他们的公会里，

zhTraditional.text: 天一亮，民間的眾長老連祭司長帶文士都聚會， 把耶穌帶到他們的公會裏，

en.text: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “IfI tell you, you won’t believe,

zhSimplified.text: 说：「你若是基督，就告诉我们。」耶稣说：「我若告诉你们，你们也不信；

zhTraditional.text: 說：「你若是基督，就告訴我們。」耶穌說：「我若告訴你們，你們也不信；

en.text: andif I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

zhSimplified.text: 我若问你们，你们也不回答。

zhTraditional.text: 我若問你們，你們也不回答。

en.text: Fromnow on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

zhSimplified.text: 从今以后，人子要坐在 神权能的右边。」

zhTraditional.text: 從今以後，人子要坐在上帝權能的右邊。」

en.text: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “Yousay it, because I am.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们都说：「这样，你是 神的儿子吗？」耶稣说：「你们所说的是。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們都說：「這樣，你是上帝的兒子嗎？」耶穌說：「你們所說的是。」

en.text: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：「何必再用見證呢？他親口所說的，我們都親自聽見了。」
